steps: OS=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); ARCH=$(uname -m); if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then ARCH="x86_64"; elif [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then ARCH="aarch64"; fi; if [ "$OS" = "darwin" ]; then OS="macos"; else OS="linux"; fi; curl -fsSL "https://ziglang.org/download/0.11.0/zig-$OS-$ARCH-0.11.0.tar.xz" -o zig.tar.xz
